title: MrTerminal configuration
description: ~/.mrterminal/config.json: projects, their open terminals, layouts, presets and commands, and app settings. While MrTerminal runs it owns this file and rewrites it within a second of any change, so edit it only while the app is closed; with the app running, use the `mrt` command instead. Missing fields get defaults and unknown fields are dropped on load.

activeProjectId.description: Id of the project on screen.

sidebarCompact.description: Project cards show only their name, without the folder path.

window.description: Window position and size; written by the app.

restoreOnLaunch.description: What happens to the previous session's terminals at start: ask every time; resume (reopen and re-run every command); layout (reopen, leave commands typed at the prompt); fresh (start empty).

shell.description: Absolute path of the shell to launch; null for the user's login shell.

showRunning.description: List what is running under each project in the sidebar.

fontFamily.description: Terminal font family; null for the built-in monospace font.

Project.description: A folder whose scripts MrTerminal offers to run.

id.description: Stable id, e.g. 8 random hex characters.

name.description: Name in the sidebar; defaults to the path.

path.description: Absolute path of the project folder. Projects whose folder no longer exists are dropped.

terminals.description: Terminals open right now, in no particular order. This is what is restored at the next start.

layout.description: Dockview layout (splits, tabs, sizes) referring to terminal ids. Optional: terminals missing from it are tiled automatically, so null is always safe.

customCommands.description: Commands the user added that are not in any script file.

presets.description: Saved sets of terminals that open together in one click.

aliases.description: Names given to detected scripts. Key: the folder relative to the project ('' for the root), a newline, then the command line, e.g. "\nnpm run dev" or "web\npnpm run dev".

expanded.description: The project's card is unfolded in the sidebar.

color.description: The project's colour; assigned automatically when missing.

Terminal.description: A terminal: the user's shell started in `cwd`, with `command` typed into it. A command's identity is command + cwd; that is how sidebar entries, presets and aliases find their terminal.

id.description: Unique among all terminals; also its id for `mrt` and its MRT_TERMINAL_ID.

cwd.description: Absolute folder the shell starts in.

command.description: Command line typed into the shell on start. Absent for a plain shell.

resume.description: Command line that was running in the terminal (typed by hand or not) when the app quit; it runs again on the next launch in place of `command`. Kept up to date by the app.

cwd.description: Folder to run in: relative to the project, absolute, or starting with ~. Absent for the project root.

terminals.description: Terminals to open. Ids only need to be unique within the preset; launching gives each a fresh id, and reuses an open terminal with the same command and cwd.

layout.description: Dockview layout referring to the ids in `terminals`; null tiles them automatically.
